description: Search for a user-provided set of motifs simultaneously (exact by default; optional IUPAC codes, reverse strand and a mismatch budget). Only motifs with at least one hit are returned; positions ascending, 0-based, forward-strand window starts. mismatches = k > 0 allows up to k substituted positions per window (Hamming distance, EMBOSS fuzznuc -pmismatch; no gaps) and adds matchMismatches / reverseMismatches (the distance of each reported hit, parallel to the position arrays).

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence: A/C/G/T plus IUPAC codes such as N (case-insensitive); a symbol other than A/C/G/T matches no motif symbol (not even N) and costs a mismatch when mismatches > 0.

bothStrands.description: Also search the reverse strand: reverseMatches lists the windows matching the reverse complement of each motif (default false).

iupac.description: Interpret IUPAC ambiguity codes in the motifs, e.g. TATAWAW (default false: codes are literal; without mismatches they match nothing, with mismatches each costs one).

mismatches.description: Maximum number of mismatching positions per hit (default 0 = exact; fuzznuc -pmismatch). A bound >= the motif length makes every window a hit.

matches.description: Map from (upper-cased) motif to its ascending 0-based positions

reverseMatches.description: Map from (upper-cased) motif to the ascending forward-strand window starts matching its reverse complement (empty unless bothStrands)

matchMismatches.description: Only with mismatches > 0: Hamming distance of each matches position (parallel array per motif)

reverseMismatches.description: Only with mismatches > 0: Hamming distance of each reverseMatches position

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
